STOP 1 • BEGIN YOUR YATRA

Parking & Village Approach

Begin by arriving with a quiet mind. The village approach marks the transition from everyday travel into a place of remembrance and pilgrimage.

Contemplate: Let each step be an offering. Keep the dham clean and respect residents and fellow pilgrims.

Prayer: May this journey bring humility, attentive remembrance and a sincere desire to serve.

A devotional note

As Gaudiya Vaishnavas, approach the dham with humility, respect for Lord Shiva as a great Vaishnava, care for the local community, and a desire to deepen nāma-saṅkīrtana and seva. The scriptural reflections offered here are devotional context; they should not be mistaken for a verified history of every local feature.
